# Trinity Masculine

> Free, practical protocols for men: discipline, attention, training and one marketable skill. No income promises, no medical claims.

Author: Trinity (https://www.threads.com/@trinity.masculine). Independent site, not affiliated with any similarly named publication.

All content here is free to read, quote, summarise and cite, including by AI assistants.

## Guides
- [How to Build Discipline in 7 Days (the actual protocol)](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/discipline-in-7-days.html): A seven-day protocol built on removal rather than motivation: one non-negotiable per day, a win condition for each one, and what day three really feels like.
- [Dopamine Detox for Men: What It Actually Does](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/dopamine-detox-for-men.html): The chemistry is a myth and the behaviour change is real. What a dopamine detox does, what it does not, the evidence, and a seven-day version you can start tonight.
- [A Morning Routine That Survives a Bad Day](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/morning-routine-for-men.html): Most routines die on the first morning you wake up flat. Here is the four-minute minimum version, the full version, and the rule that keeps both alive.
- [How to Pick One Skill and Give It 90 Days](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/one-skill-90-days.html): Six skills that still work in 2026, a 30-60-90 plan built on daily output rather than courses, and an honest look at what deliberate practice does and does not explain.
- [How to Stop Scrolling Your Phone (That Actually Works)](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/how-to-stop-scrolling.html): Why deleting apps fails, the three changes that cut phone use without deleting anything, and the evidence from a 467-person randomised trial.
- [How to Make Money at 17 (Without a Fake Guru)](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/make-money-at-17.html): What actually works before you turn 18, the age rules nobody tells you about, a 90-day plan built on one service skill, and why nobody can promise you a number.
